    # lattice lines. Sample the crossings; background-colored cells there

            sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(h)) >= 2]

    def lattice(xs):

    rows, cols = lattice(rows), lattice(cols)
    if len(rows) >= 2 and len(cols) >= 2:
        return [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows[:-1]]

    # stripes are not part of the small output; they provide its fill color.
